paper_id: Li et al. - 2009 - Joint Throughput Optimization for Wireless Mesh Networks
title: Joint Throughput Optimization for Wireless Mesh Networks
motivation: WMN部署受限于干扰导致的容量衰减,多信道多-radio可缓解但需联合优化
problem_framing: 将路由/链路调度/信道分配建模为混合整数规划并relax为LP
key_insight: 虚拟节点分裂法将多radio节点映射为全互联节点,使得调度问题可分离求解
method_signature: 跨层LP松弛+冲突图着色调度+constant近似比证明
evaluation_criteria: fairness和throughput与最优解的常数因子差距
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 理论界保守,实际仿真性能远优于理论边界
evidence_for_taste: we are the first one to prove asymptotic optimal bounds
performs much better than the theoretical bounds
To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to study channel combining
thinking_moves: 统一建模四种干扰模型下的调度问题
通过虚拟化将异构radio constraints转化为统一图模型
先证最坏情况常数近似,再凭仿真展示实际优势
从LP最优解反推调度可行条件作为充分条件
